data_output.description: Provide the existing encoded split contract with features shaped [N,4] and columns [user_id_index, video_id_index, decayed_prior_long_view_positive_count, decayed_prior_long_view_negative_count], labels shaped [N], and user_ids shaped [N]. History columns must be precomputed in chronological order using only events with timestamps strictly earlier than the current event, with deterministic ordering for equal timestamps and no cross-split leakage. Rows must retain source order within every split, especially validation order, so the fixed trainer writes canonical row_ids and scores without reordering. No evaluator ground truth is included in model outputs.

model_input.description: Model receives the [N,4] feature matrix and binary long_view labels for pointwise training. Preserve additive user/item effects and low-rank interaction, and add two independently learned scalar coefficients for the positive-history and negative-history columns. Keep the existing optimizer controls, loss, validation proxy, early stopping, checkpoint restoration, and prediction API. Predictions must be one finite score per input row in input order; the fixed training command must write an NPZ containing exactly row_ids and scores.
